claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.destinationOverride
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation shape can grant access to named spells, but it cannot constrain or override the destination parameter of a granted spell cast. Cubic Gate's core mechanic is that the cast destination is the plane keyed to the pressed cube face, not an unrestricted spell choice.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Gate. Pressing one side of the cube, you cast Gate, opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side."

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_cubic_gate.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
